description: This file defines a Flutter widget called AuthScaffold, which provides a styled scaffold with a gradient background, safe area, and padding, used to encapsulate other child widgets within the app's authentication screens.

classes.name: AuthScaffold
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides a styled scaffold with a gradient background, safe area, and padding for child widgets.
